caseName: Broadcast Music, Inc. v. Columbia Broadcasting System, Inc.
caseNameFull: Broadcast Music, Inc. v. Columbia Broadcasting System, Inc. and American Society of Composers, Authors & Publishers v. Columbia Broadcasting System, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 817.] Motion of Columbia Broadcasting System, Inc., for additional time for oral argument granted and 15 additional minutes allotted for that purpose. Petitioners also allotted 15 additional minutes for oral argument.
